cefrAlignment: C1-level argumentative writing in a professional register, with comparative justification and extended examples; the model essays are fluent and error-free.
examFidelity: The TOEIC Write an opinion essay facts (final question, 30 minutes, at least 300 words typical of an effective essay, scored on reasons/examples, grammar, vocabulary and organisation) match exams.ts and ETS; the three prompt types are stated as common, not fixed.
fixes: Added 'in contrast' as an accepted answer in the gap fill
openConcerns: The lesson includes a full 30-minute timed essay, so the 25 minutes listed (fixed by the content guide for lessons 5–11) understates the real study time (about 50–60 minutes).
learnerOutcome: Learners can plan and write a well-organised 300+ word TOEIC opinion essay in 30 minutes that answers the exact prompt type and justifies their choice comparatively.
